I'm a mixed-methods researcher working across sociology and computer science. I study how communities and institutions draw boundaries: who belongs, who gets watched, and how those lines come to feel normal.

I've come at this question through ethnography, applied policy research, and user research on digital platforms. Now I'm combining that work with computational methods. I'm finishing an MS in Applied Quantitative Research for Social Analysis, concentrating in Computational Social Science, at Northeastern University.

If you'd like to collaborate or just talk research: [kelbrown017@gmail.com](mailto:kelbrown017@gmail.com)
